Clear: clear sky conditions, crisp air, clean distant detail
Partly cloudy: partly cloudy sky, soft cloud diffusion mixed with sun breaks
Overcast: overcast cloud layer, broad soft light, muted shadows
Foggy: foggy atmosphere, softened distance, lowered contrast, air perspective
Rainy: rainy conditions, wet surfaces, specular ground reflections, heavy air
Snowy: snowy weather, soft white ground cover, cool reflected fill
Windy: windy conditions, motion in hair, fabric, and foliage
